label: Type text
description: Type text on the computer's keyboard, into whatever has the focus: `args` is `{ text }`. A newline in the text presses Return.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: The text, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `type` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: Type text into whatever has the focus; click the field first. A newline presses Return.
anthropic.name: type

openai.description: Type text into whatever has the focus; click the field first. A newline presses Enter.
openai.name: type
